goals: PRIMARY (mechanistic): quantify hillslope-to-stream travel times, lateral flow convergence along topographic flowpaths, and groundwater exchange between neighboring hillslope positions

SUPPORTING (feasible fragment): characterize the vertical water balance / recharge (QDRAI) and soil-moisture states at distinct topographic positions that would serve as inputs to a lateral flow model
key_processes: advective travel time from hillslope to stream
vertical recharge/drainage (the only piece ELM resolves)

model_choice.rationale: The question is about lateral transport, which the single-column ELM stack cannot represent. ELM can only supply the vertical recharge/drainage flux and soil-moisture state at points along a toposequence; it cannot compute travel times or inter-hillslope exchange. A lateral solver (coupled PFLOTRAN or a routing/hillslope model) is required.
model_choice.coupling_note: Answering the question requires ELM vertical drainage (QDRAI) to drive a lateral, hillslope-resolving subsurface model (e.g. PFLOTRAN with a 2-D/3-D hillslope mesh) that solves flow convergence and produces travel times. This ELM->PFLOTRAN weak coupling is NOT implemented (see requires_capabilities).

answerable: vertical water balance and recharge/drainage flux (QDRAI) at individual topographic positions
per-position soil-moisture and water-table state (with spin-up / WTD warm start), usable as boundary conditions for a lateral model

not_answerable.why: Single-column ELM has no lateral transport and no routing; travel time along a flowpath is undefined for independent 1-D columns.
not_answerable.needs: lateral subsurface flow + advective transport / routing solver

not_answerable.aspect: lateral flow convergence along topographic flowpaths
not_answerable.why: No column-to-column exchange or terrain-following flow accumulation exists in the single-column stack.
not_answerable.needs: flowpath-resolving lateral flow model (coupled PFLOTRAN hillslope mesh or hillslope hydrology model)

not_answerable.aspect: groundwater exchange between neighboring hillslope positions
not_answerable.why: Columns are independent 1-D points; there is no regional water table and no inter-column groundwater flux.
not_answerable.needs: ELM->PFLOTRAN weak coupling with lateral groundwater flow

sampling_strategy.approach: clustered toposequence (ridge -> midslope -> footslope -> valley/riparian) — ONLY as a recharge/BC generator, NOT as a resolver of lateral flow
sampling_strategy.n_justification: A single representative ridge-to-stream toposequence of 4 positions spans the hillslope gradient whose vertical recharge would feed a lateral model. More columns are not justified because ELM cannot use them to produce the requested lateral quantities; the value is limited to per-position BC fluxes.
sampling_strategy.placement_logic: Positions arranged along one representative hillslope from an upland ridge down to a valley/riparian zone; concentrate near the footslope/riparian transition where groundwater-soil-moisture exchange would be strongest (though ELM cannot resolve that exchange).
sampling_strategy.replication: none — a single transect is sufficient for a BC-generation fragment; replication is pointless until a lateral solver exists to consume the fluxes.

sampling_plan.reason: Recharge source cell at the flowpath head; supplies upslope vertical drainage flux as a lateral-model input.
Transmissive throughflow zone; provides midslope recharge/soil-moisture state for the lateral model.
Convergence/accumulation zone where lateral exchange would peak; ELM gives only its vertical flux, flagging the missing lateral term.
Discharge / near-stream position; supplies the downslope boundary state for travel-time computation in a lateral model.

none — observations_available is empty for this domain

requires_capabilities.blocks: the entire primary question (travel times, convergence)

requires_capabilities.capability: ELM->PFLOTRAN weak coupling (QDRAI -> lateral hillslope mesh recharge BC)
requires_capabilities.why: Needed to pass ELM vertical drainage into a lateral groundwater model that resolves inter-position exchange.
requires_capabilities.blocks: groundwater exchange between neighboring hillslope positions
